name: bundled-requirement-decomposition
body: `requirements.requirement.reviewer-upgrade-removal-guide` addresses the upgrade friction of a repo that already carries a repo-local `implementation-phase-reviewer.md`; it is one requirement alongside the reviewer-distribution requirement `requirements.requirement.reviewer-is-distributed-not-generated`, and its manual-removal instruction is separately testable user-facing behaviour (`APG_UPGRADE_DOC` plus the `upgrade_doc_covers_version_field_gate_and_fix_steps` needle). It is parented under `requirements.user.apg-upgrader`, and `reviewer-is-distributed-not-generated` is parented under `requirements.stakeholder.agent-suite-maintainer`, so the `contains` hierarchy is a tree.
